fact: The SSRA Commissioner General directed that all government revenues, including taxes, be paid exclusively through the National e-Tax System, with electronic receipts as proof of payment, per Sudans Post.

Commissioner General Rizig Dominic Samuel says that under the electronic system taxpayers pay directly through authorised commercial banks, with transactions recorded in the system; e-Tax was demonstrated to the Zambian delegation.

The SSRA is rolling out its e-tax system, described as a platform to automate tax filings and payments, with seven of its state head offices digitized so far and others to follow, per One Citizen Daily quoting the Commissioner of Domestic Taxes.

One Citizen Daily reports the SSRA review of its E-Tax reform, a platform designed for tax registration, filing and payment, noting strides in automating tax filing alongside limited infrastructure and low taxpayer awareness.
